style_figure: Photograph of a premium hand-painted tabletop miniature figure, serious and highly detailed. Proportions: the whole figure is 2.8 head-heights tall, the head with its helmet is 35 percent of the total height, very broad shoulders 1.8 times the width of the head, short thick legs one head-height long, large gloved hands and heavy boots. Matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights and subtle panel-line shading. Stern, serious mood. Full figure standing directly on the ground with no base, front three-quarter view, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.
style_creature: Photograph of a premium hand-painted tabletop miniature of a creature, serious and highly detailed, matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights, unsettling mood. Whole creature in frame standing directly on the ground with no base, front three-quarter view, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.

items.prompt: Subject: a civil-defence security agent of a 1950s vision of the future. Quilted cream fabric uniform with teal shoulder yoke and teal ribbed collar, a short hard chest plate in cream enamel with one coral stripe, wide belt with rounded pouches, ribbed rubber gloves, tall teal boots. Rounded open-face helmet in cream enamel with a chrome rim and a dark tinted goggle strip covering the eyes, stern mouth visible. Holds a compact rounded carbine with a chrome barrel shroud and small cooling fins, pointed at the ground.

Subject: an agent in a sleek form-fitting moulded protection suit from a 1950s vision of the future. Smooth seamless plates that follow the body like a second skin, pearl white on the torso and thighs, deep teal on the shoulders, forearms, shins and sides, one thin coral chevron line across the upper chest, fine chrome rings at the neck, wrists and ankles. Seamless smooth domed helmet in pearl white that fully covers the head, with a single narrow horizontal black visor band and no other features. No chest light, no crest, no antenna. Holds a long smooth rifle with a chrome ringed barrel across the body.

Subject: an agent in a sleek form-fitting moulded flight suit from a 1950s vision of the future. Smooth seamless plates that follow the body, pearl white torso and thighs, deep teal shoulders, forearms and shins, one thin coral chevron line across the upper chest. Two rounded turbine pods with chrome intake rings mounted on the upper back and visible above the shoulders, small swept stabiliser fins on the forearms and calves, thicker boots with exhaust vents in the soles. Seamless smooth domed helmet in pearl white with a single narrow horizontal black visor band. No chest light, no crest. Holds a short rounded carbine in one hand.

Subject: an ordinary office clerk of a 1950s vision of the future who has been taken over by an alien organism. Mustard suit jacket, narrow tie, grey trousers, polished shoes, short neat hair, blank calm face with pale glassy eyes. A translucent pale sea-green growth like branching sea-glass coral spreads up the back of the neck, along the jaw and over one hand, with a faint amber glow inside it. Arms hanging at the sides, head tilted slightly.

Subject: a small alien organism the size of a house cat. A translucent pale sea-green bell-shaped body like blown sea glass with a faint amber glow inside, standing on six thin jointed legs of dark glossy chitin, a cluster of fine branching coral-like feelers under the bell. No eyes, no face, no visible brain.

Subject: a tall alien fighting organism, taller than a person, grown rather than born. A lean tripod body on three long backward-jointed legs of dark glossy chitin, a narrow torso sheathed in overlapping translucent pale sea-green plates like sea glass with an amber glow in the gaps, two long arms that end in branching coral-like blades, a smooth eyeless wedge-shaped head.

Photograph of a premium hand-painted scale model of a small two-seat hovering patrol craft from a 1950s vision of the future, rounded teardrop body in cream enamel with a teal belly and one coral stripe, clear bubble canopy, chrome intake ring at the nose, two small swept tail fins, three rounded lift pods underneath, no wheels. Matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights. Side three-quarter view, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.

Wide establishing view of a gleaming city of tomorrow as imagined in the 1950s, at golden morning light: white domes, slender spires with ring platforms, elevated sky-roads curving between towers, a monorail, small rounded flying cars, green terraces and fountains, tiny well-dressed crowds. Palette of cream, teal, coral and mustard under a pale turquoise sky. Painted mid-century travel-poster illustration with soft gouache texture, optimistic and clean, with one tower in the distance dark and unlit.

Isometric cutaway view from above of two floors of an office building lobby in a 1950s vision of the future, walls cut away to show the rooms: terrazzo floor with a visible square tile grid, curved reception desk in teal enamel, kidney-shaped tables, globe lamps, potted palms, pneumatic message tubes on the walls, a sweeping staircase to a mezzanine with glass partitions and desks. Cream, teal, coral and mustard palette, soft daylight from tall windows. Clean detailed game environment concept art, empty of people.

Front view of a civil-defence control console from a 1950s vision of the future: cream enamel panels with chrome bead edges and visible screw heads, rows of small round lamps in green, mustard and coral, labelled toggle switches, a large round dial with a needle, a big paddle switch, a tray holding small printed paper message slips, a circular glass map screen showing a simple city plan in teal lines. Clean product photograph, soft even light, no people.
